title: Optimized & Beautiful
description: A modpack aimed at optimizing Minecraft 1.20.1.
body:
**A modpack aimed at optimizing Minecraft 1.20.1.**

I started thinking about optimizing the game because, as everyone knows, vanilla Minecraft is poorly optimized. I decided to customize Minecraft for myself and decided to post it on modrinth. Good luck in use it!

**My PC:** 
**_AMD Radeon HD 6670_**
**_AMD Athlon II X2 240_**
**_4GB RAM 533MHz_**
